system.description: Touching the target and spending two Blood Traits, the vampire engages the victim's Physical Traits with his own Social Traits (retest with Occult) to age the subject up to a number of years determined by Traits successfully risked, per a Storyteller-set chart. To instead reduce the target's age, the wielder spends a Physical Trait and suffers one unresistable lethal wound per Trait risked. Only physical age changes; mental faculties, Disciplines, and Attributes gained through experience are unaffected, and a subject can never be regressed past full maturity, birth, or (for Kindred) the age of their Embrace. Failing any Temporis use at Advanced level or higher inflicts an aggravated wound per consecutive failure after the first.
